name: aw-flaky-race
prompt: Which test is flaky and what race condition causes it?
rawOutput:
Flaky test report (last 50 CI runs)
test_upload_then_list ....... failed 7/50 (flaky)
test_login .................. passed 50/50
test_logout ................. passed 50/50
Analysis: test_upload_then_list asserts the file appears immediately, but the
uploader writes asynchronously — a race between the write and the list call.
Repro: the failure only happens when the CI worker is under load.
Fix hint: await the upload completion callback before listing in tests/test_files.py
Note: retrying masks the bug and is discouraged
Note: full logs archived in the CI artifacts bucket
requiredFacts: await the upload completion callback before listing in tests/test_files.py
